meta.description: Keeps an Apple Music playlist and a YouTube Music playlist in sync

login.subtitle: Sign in to continue.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
login.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.

home.title: Home
home.description: Keeps an Apple Music playlist and a YouTube Music playlist in sync.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: They are stored encrypted and never shown again. To change one, save it again.
credentials.appleHelp: Signed in on music.apple.com, open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://music.apple.com and copy the value of media-user-token. It lasts about 180 days.
credentials.youtubeHelp: In a private window, sign in on music.youtube.com. Open DevTools → Network, pick a request to /youtubei/ and copy the whole Cookie header. Then close that window without signing out.
credentials.tokenOld: This token is {days} days old and expires around day 180. Renew it soon.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.description: Choose or create one playlist on each service. Only those two are synced.
playlists.changeWarning: Changing either one restarts syncing the pair and switches back to dry-run.
playlists.noneEditable: No playlists you can edit were found. Create one below.
playlists.confirmChange: I understand that syncing the current pair starts over.
playlists.mustConfirm: Confirm the change: syncing the current pair starts over.
playlists.notEditable: That playlist cannot be edited from your account.

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: Check what each service allows from this server.
tests.choosePlaylistsFirst: The tests use the chosen playlists: choose them first in Playlists.
tests.readHelp: Read only. Shows which connection works on Apple Music and reads both chosen playlists.
tests.writeHelp: Adds and removes one song on each chosen playlist, and can take a few minutes. It never touches a song already in them, so pick one that is in neither.
tests.inUse: This is the combination in use.
tests.queryRequired: Enter a song you do not have.
tests.couldNotStart: The test could not be started.

probe.alreadyThere: It is already in the playlist, so it is left alone. Pick another one.
probe.notShown: It did not show up in the playlist. If it shows up later, remove "{song}" by hand.
probe.stillThere: The request succeeded but the song is still in the playlist
probe.appleRemoveFailed: No method could remove "{song}" from the playlist. Remove it by hand. Full mode stays blocked.
probe.youtubeStillThere: Still in the playlist: "{song}". Remove it by hand.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fullLocked: Full mode is enabled once the add and remove test passes on both playlists.
settings.confirmFull: I understand that a song removed from one playlist will also be removed from the other.
settings.storefrontHint: Two letters, for example us or ar.
settings.passwordFailed: The password could not be changed. Check the current password.
settings.outOfRange: Check the values: one of them is out of range.
settings.fullRequiresTest: Full mode requires the add and remove test to pass on both playlists.
settings.confirmFullRequired: Confirm that you want removals to be copied.
settings.savedNextCycle: Saved. It applies from the next cycle.

history.title: History
history.description: Recent cycles, with what was done or would be done.
history.overLimit: Nothing was removed: the per-cycle limit was exceeded.

blockedReasons.apple_read_incomplete: The Apple Music read did not finish
blockedReasons.youtube_read_incomplete: The YouTube Music read did not finish
blockedReasons.apple_read_empty: Apple Music returned an empty playlist although songs were linked
blockedReasons.youtube_read_empty: YouTube Music returned an empty playlist although songs were linked

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Songs that are not synced until you decide what to do.

reasons.duplicate_target: Another song already uses that match

errors.saveCredentialFirst: Save the credential for this service first.
errors.cannotDecrypt: Saved credentials cannot be decrypted. If APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed, save them again.
errors.appleRemoveNotVerified: Removing songs from Apple Music playlists is not verified
errors.youtubeSessionInvalid: The YouTube session is not valid: save the cookie again
errors.youtubeNoPlaylist: YouTube did not return the created playlist
